from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalance(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cash and cash equivalents data from a single financial document."""
    entity_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company or fund the filing belongs to")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line-item label as written in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency symbol or code (e.g., '$', 'USD')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalance]
